text:
micah_support: Quick escalation 9Orbitly (trial acct 9876) has repeated embed-ingest 502s last 18h. Ticket #12345. Requeues not fixing it. Logs: `embed_worker timeout 504 | kv-cache miss spike`. Renewal ~60d out. Need CS-led comms + prioritized onboarding checklist asap.

ashley_cs: Copy. @diego_se can you triage? Offer same-day call.

diego_se: Preliminary: cache eviction + client retry bursts. Short-term fix: lower batch_size to 8 + enable tenant prefix cache. I'll run staging test.

micah_support: Canary with batch_size=8 up at 12:30. Customer reporting degraded recommendations; they want a 3pm PST call.

emma_onboard_pm: I'll join and run the checklist: collect failing UUIDs, confirm duplicate sends, plan 1hr reingest window + rollback. Micah paste a couple sample UUIDs?

micah_support: Sample UUIDs in ticket: b4f3e2a1, f9c2d7b8. Also seeing token_count spikes during bursts, maybe client resends.

diego_se: Staging looks good: ~90% fewer timeouts. Promoting to canary prod and watching similarity histograms. If stable, full rollout + reingest in ~2h with read-only fallback.

ashley_cs: Draft message to customer ready: "Were sorry weve identified ingestion backpressure causing timeouts and degraded embeddings. Weve deployed a mitigation and request a 1hr window to reingest a verified data window. Well update every 2 hours." Will post after approvals.

nina_sales: I'll standby for the call re: renewal risk if it comes up.

ops-bot: Canary start tenant=orbitly id=c-1729 at 1759001150

diego_se: Canary metrics initial: ~95% drop in 502s first 10m; no embedding drift seen yet.

ashley_cs: Plan for 3pm call: 1) brief RCA 2) mitigation + timelines 3) request 1hr reingest window 4) next steps & follow-ups. Post-call: open eval for embedding quality, add Orbitly to renewal-watchboard, capture feedback.

micah_support: Updated ticket with canary KPIs and meeting invite. Thanks team.

ops-bot: Canary promoted to full rollout for tenant=orbitly at 1759001280
